test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers in the following set.

(Note: Operations must be performed on the whole numbers without breaking them down into their constituent digits. For example, take 13 – operations can be performed on 13, such as adding/subtracting/multiplying, etc. Breaking 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(92, 6, 552)

(98, 5, 490)
solution:
• 
 
The logic followed here is:

 
Logic: 

 
 
• 
 
**Third number = First number × Second number**

 
(92, 6, 552) 

 
⇒ (92 × 6) = 552.

 
(98, 5, 490)

 
⇒ (98 × 5) = 490.​

 
Now, checking the options:

 
Option 1) (52, 8, 438)

 
⇒ (52 × 8) ≠ 438.

 
Option 2) (46, 9, 405)

 
⇒ (46 × 9) ≠ 405.

 
Option 3) (48, 6, 478)

 
⇒ (48 × 6) ≠ 478.

 
**Option 4) (84, 7, 588)**

 
**⇒ (84 × 7) = 588.**

 
 
• 
 
Hence, the correct option is "Option 4 "
